name: list_bulk_redirects
description:
List a project's bulk redirect rules, optionally selecting a version, filtering rules, or comparing versions. Supports sorting and pagination. Use list_bulk_redirect_versions for version history.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/bulk-redirects --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
